title: [AndroidAPS 3.2.0.3] Suggestion: GUI change bolus wizard
body:
I would like to suggest a GUI change for bolus wizard.
The line "carb time" can be included in the table with the other input fields. 
If the details are hidden, the line could still be visible. 
See attached pictures.
I changed the file "dialog_wizard.xml" locally and I like to provide this file. 
(But I also like to avoid the effort to learn the processes about pull requests.) ;o)
Please give me a hint how I can share the changed file, if you are interested.

![Bolus_Wizard_long](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/16593716/57567e68-4b75-41f9-806b-29a3cb3a0b37)
![Bolus_Wizard_Short](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/16593716/4bde589a-e515-41e1-8302-fcc06db77de5)
